name: 66214 · Overland Park, KS
findings: ZIP 66214 (Overland Park) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66214 (Overland Park) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
